data.summary:
Seeking a challenging role in product-based companies, driving digital transformation, product innovation, and revenue growth through strategic program management, AI-driven insights, and agile execution.
Highly competent, Hands-on & performance-driven management professional bringing 20+ years of expertise in the world of digital transformation, and enterprise technology, in the Fintech, Retail, Energy & Utility domains by relentlessly driving for innovation, growth, and impact defining every endeavor.
As a Senior Program Manager at PayPal, steering high-stakes programs with precision, ensuring seamless execution across credit collections for consumers and merchants, enterprise, risk and regulatory.
A leader in cloud computing, Voice Agentic AI, Agentic AI Chatbot, data engineering, and regulatory compliance, digital payments, credit collections, BNPL, consumer lending platform, merchant lending platform, and fraud detection.
Bridging technology with business strategy, wielding expertise in governance, P&L management, and stakeholder engagement, and securing high-value partnerships across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC.
An agile transformation specialist, optimizing workflows, fostering collaboration, and driving operational resilience in global financial ecosystems.

experience.role: Senior Program Manager (TPMO - Technical Program Management Office)

responsibilities: Spearheaded the platform migration from a legacy infrastructure & application version to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.

Upgraded the Sample Manager application (a Platinum CoS application) alongside the infrastructure to align with the latest technology standards & led governance reporting, change management, and risk management, and conducted root cause analysis to ensure seamless project execution.
Successfully led and delivered a high-value £800K fixed-price program, ensuring all milestones were met on time with full payment received.
Achieved an outstanding 7/7 customer satisfaction rating.

Oversaw governance reporting, change management, and risk management, and performed root cause analysis to enhance system efficiency and reliability.

awards, the journey is a relentless pursuit of excellence, disruption, and game-changing innovation in the financial world.
Achievements:
•
Program leadership, ensuring business strategy is seamlessly integrated with product and engineering, resulting in achieving the desired business benefit.
• Managing around fifteen high-impact initiatives in the Credit Collections portfolio (Consumer, Merchant and Regulatory), driving


execution oversight throughout the program lifecycle, governance, and managing risks. Fostering cross-functional collaboration across Business, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Operational Excellence, Operations, and Vendor Management (including third-party), to achieve critical program milestones. Leading executive-level engagements, ensuring strategic alignment and cross-functional synergy to support business and operational priorities.
Optimizing resources, enhancing service delivery, and ensuring regulatory compliance by leveraging financial and operational insights


to drive efficiency, budget precision, and long-term business growth. Leading end-to-end Program Management for the Credit Collections portfolio, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with business objectives. Implementing robust tracking and governance mechanisms, ensuring transparency in project status, key milestones and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management, proactively identifying, and mitigating potential challenges to ensure program success.
Achievements: •
Spearheaded the cloud migration from on-premise Netezza to Microsoft Azure to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.
Owned and managed a $3M annual revenue portfolio, driving delivery excellence across Data & Analytics accounts in the Insurance and


Reinsurance domains (Chubb). Led the turnaround of two high-risk, red-status accounts, successfully stabilizing operations, restoring client confidence, and securing contract renewals with additional headcount expansion. Played a pivotal role in pre-sales initiatives, contributing to a robust $15M sales pipeline through domain expertise and strategic client engagements.
Governance & Agile Leadership: • Account Management & Leadership Reviews – Oversaw growth strategy, profitability, staffing, risk & issue management across



multiple accounts. Change & Risk Management – Led quality assurance, root-cause analysis, and risk mitigation to ensure smooth and efficient project execution. Financial & Contract Governance – Managed contract negotiations, invoice management, and commercial oversight to align financials with delivery objectives. Client Engagement & Strategic Partnerships – Maintained a continuous feedback loop with client leadership, fostering transparency, trust, and long-term collaboration.
Technology & Tools: • • • • Database & BI Tools: MS SQL Server, Data Quality, Power BI
Agile/DevOps: Jira, Microsoft Project Cloud & Data Platforms: Azure Cloud, Enterprise Data Warehouse, Data Mart ETL & Data Integration: Netezza, Informatica IICS, Informatica 10.2.1
Impact & Value Delivered: By driving data-driven digital transformation in the Insurance & Reinsurance sector, successfully delivered scalable analytics solutions, enhanced data quality, and enabled clients to make informed business decisions—leading to revenue growth, operational stability, and long-term client trust.
Achievements: • Owned and managed a $10M annual revenue portfolio, overseeing the delivery of all accounts within the FinTech domain (PayPal). • Drove exponential growth in a key FinTech account, scaling revenue from $2.5M to $8M through consistent delivery excellence.


Established an Offshore Development Centre (ODC) and streamlined delivery processes to enhance efficiency. Successfully turned around a high-risk, red-status account in the transportation domain, stabilizing operations, restoring customer confidence, and securing a contract renewal. Actively contributed to pre-sales initiatives, leveraging deep domain expertise to drive new business opportunities.

Internal Leadership Reviews – Oversaw account management, including growth strategy, margin optimization, staffing, risk & issue management.

o Facilitated daily standups to ensure alignment and progress tracking. o Led sprint planning, protecting teams from scope creep and ensuring realistic commitments. o Engaged in sprint reviews, capturing valuable stakeholder feedback for iterative improvements. o Conducted retrospectives, identifying key areas for continuous improvement. • Risk & Issue Management, Root-Cause Analysis, and Change Management to ensure high-quality deliveries. • Contract & Invoice Management, ensuring seamless financial and operational alignment with client expectations. • Maintained an ongoing client leadership review & feedback loop to drive transparency and sustained collaboration.
Technology & Tools: Product Development Stack: • •
Agile/DevOps: Rally, Kanban, CI/CD, GitLab, TeamCity, Octopus Cloud & Backend: Azure Cloud, PostgreSQL, .NET, Java, NodeJS, Python
• • • UX/UI Design: Sketch, Adobe XD, Illustrator • Mobile Development: iOS, Android
Frontend & Mobile: ReactJS, Angular (Ionic), JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dreamweaver Automation & QA: Selenium, Galen
Impact & Value Delivered: By combining deep FinTech domain expertise, strong governance, and agile best practices, successfully delivered scalable, high-impact solutions that improved customer confidence, drove revenue growth, and ensured seamless digital transformations for global clients.

A leader in cloud computing, Voice Agentic AI, Agentic AI Chatbot, data engineering, and regulatory compliance, digital payments, credit collections, BNPL, consumer lending platform, merchant lending platform, and fraud detection. Bridging technology with business strategy, wielding expertise in governance, P&L management, and stakeholder engagement, and securing high-value partnerships across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC. An agile transformation specialist, optimizing workflows, fostering collaboration, and driving operational resilience in global financial ecosystems.

sections.label: Awards and achievements
sections.text:
awards, the journey is a relentless pursuit of excellence, disruption, and game-changing innovation in the financial world.
Achievements:
•
Program leadership, ensuring business strategy is seamlessly integrated with product and engineering, resulting in achieving the desired business benefit.
• Managing around fifteen high-impact initiatives in the Credit Collections portfolio (Consumer, Merchant and Regulatory), driving


execution oversight throughout the program lifecycle, governance, and managing risks. Fostering cross-functional collaboration across Business, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Operational Excellence, Operations, and Vendor Management (including third-party), to achieve critical program milestones. Leading executive-level engagements, ensuring strategic alignment and cross-functional synergy to support business and operational priorities.
Optimizing resources, enhancing service delivery, and ensuring regulatory compliance by leveraging financial and operational insights


to drive efficiency, budget precision, and long-term business growth. Leading end-to-end Program Management for the Credit Collections portfolio, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with business objectives. Implementing robust tracking and governance mechanisms, ensuring transparency in project status, key milestones and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management, proactively identifying, and mitigating potential challenges to ensure program success.
Achievements: •
Spearheaded the cloud migration from on-premise Netezza to Microsoft Azure to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.
Owned and managed a $3M annual revenue portfolio, driving delivery excellence across Data & Analytics accounts in the Insurance and


Reinsurance domains (Chubb). Led the turnaround of two high-risk, red-status accounts, successfully stabilizing operations, restoring client confidence, and securing contract renewals with additional headcount expansion. Played a pivotal role in pre-sales initiatives, contributing to a robust $15M sales pipeline through domain expertise and strategic client engagements.
Governance & Agile Leadership: • Account Management & Leadership Reviews – Oversaw growth strategy, profitability, staffing, risk & issue management across



multiple accounts. Change & Risk Management – Led quality assurance, root-cause analysis, and risk mitigation to ensure smooth and efficient project execution. Financial & Contract Governance – Managed contract negotiations, invoice management, and commercial oversight to align financials with delivery objectives. Client Engagement & Strategic Partnerships – Maintained a continuous feedback loop with client leadership, fostering transparency, trust, and long-term collaboration.
Technology & Tools: • • • • Database & BI Tools: MS SQL Server, Data Quality, Power BI
Agile/DevOps: Jira, Microsoft Project Cloud & Data Platforms: Azure Cloud, Enterprise Data Warehouse, Data Mart ETL & Data Integration: Netezza, Informatica IICS, Informatica 10.2.1
Impact & Value Delivered: By driving data-driven digital transformation in the Insurance & Reinsurance sector, successfully delivered scalable analytics solutions, enhanced data quality, and enabled clients to make informed business decisions—leading to revenue growth, operational stability, and long-term client trust.
Achievements: • Owned and managed a $10M annual revenue portfolio, overseeing the delivery of all accounts within the FinTech domain (PayPal). • Drove exponential growth in a key FinTech account, scaling revenue from $2.5M to $8M through consistent delivery excellence.


Established an Offshore Development Centre (ODC) and streamlined delivery processes to enhance efficiency. Successfully turned around a high-risk, red-status account in the transportation domain, stabilizing operations, restoring customer confidence, and securing a contract renewal. Actively contributed to pre-sales initiatives, leveraging deep domain expertise to drive new business opportunities.
Governance & Agile Leadership: •
Internal Leadership Reviews – Oversaw account management, including growth strategy, margin optimization, staffing, risk & issue management.
Agile & Scrum Best Practices:
o Facilitated daily standups to ensure alignment and progress tracking. o Led sprint planning, protecting teams from scope creep and ensuring realistic commitments. o Engaged in sprint reviews, capturing valuable stakeholder feedback for iterative improvements. o Conducted retrospectives, identifying key areas for continuous improvement. • Risk & Issue Management, Root-Cause Analysis, and Change Management to ensure high-quality deliveries. • Contract & Invoice Management, ensuring seamless financial and operational alignment with client expectations. • Maintained an ongoing client leadership review & feedback loop to drive transparency and sustained collaboration.
Technology & Tools: Product Development Stack: • •
Agile/DevOps: Rally, Kanban, CI/CD, GitLab, TeamCity, Octopus Cloud & Backend: Azure Cloud, PostgreSQL, .NET, Java, NodeJS, Python
• • • UX/UI Design: Sketch, Adobe XD, Illustrator • Mobile Development: iOS, Android
Frontend & Mobile: ReactJS, Angular (Ionic), JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dreamweaver Automation & QA: Selenium, Galen
Impact & Value Delivered: By combining deep FinTech domain expertise, strong governance, and agile best practices, successfully delivered scalable, high-impact solutions that improved customer confidence, drove revenue growth, and ensured seamless digital transformations for global clients. 
AWARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS
Diamond Award from the COO for achieving a Top 20 rating for two consecutive years • Winner of the Dialing for Dollars contest • Silver Award for Integrity, presented by HR

targets.text: Managing around fifteen high-impact initiatives in the Credit Collections portfolio (Consumer, Merchant and Regulatory), driving
execution oversight throughout the program lifecycle, governance, and managing risks.
Fostering cross-functional collaboration across Business, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Operational
Excellence, Operations, and Vendor Management (including third-party), to achieve critical program milestones.
Leading executive-level engagements, ensuring strategic alignment and cross-functional synergy to support business and operational
priorities.
Optimizing resources, enhancing service delivery, and ensuring regulatory compliance by leveraging financial and operational insights
to drive efficiency, budget precision, and long-term business growth.
Leading end-to-end Program Management for the Credit Collections portfolio, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with business
objectives.
Implementing robust tracking and governance mechanisms, ensuring transparency in project status, key milestones and RAID (Risks,
Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management, proactively identifying, and mitigating potential challenges to ensure program
success.
Key Responsibilities &
Genpact Headstrong Capital Markets – Sr. Manager (Senior Principal Consultant) | Bengaluru | July 2017 – Sep 2021
Spearheaded the cloud migration from on-premise Netezza to Microsoft Azure to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business
continuity and compliance.
Owned and managed a $3M annual revenue portfolio, driving delivery excellence across Data & Analytics accounts in the Insurance and
Reinsurance domains (Chubb).
Led the turnaround of two high-risk, red-status accounts, successfully stabilizing operations, restoring client confidence, and securing
contract renewals with additional headcount expansion.
Played a pivotal role in pre-sales initiatives, contributing to a robust $15M sales pipeline through domain expertise and strategic client
engagements.
Governance & Agile Leadership:
Account Management & Leadership Reviews – Oversaw growth strategy, profitability, staffing, risk & issue management across
multiple accounts.
Change & Risk Management – Led quality assurance, root-cause analysis, and risk mitigation to ensure smooth and efficient project
execution.
Financial & Contract Governance – Managed contract negotiations, invoice management, and commercial oversight to align financials
with delivery objectives.
Client Engagement & Strategic Partnerships – Maintained a continuous feedback loop with client leadership, fostering transparency,
trust, and long-term collaboration.
Technology & Tools:
Database & BI Tools: MS SQL Server, Data Quality, Power BI
Agile/DevOps: Jira, Microsoft Project
Cloud & Data Platforms: Azure Cloud, Enterprise Data Warehouse, Data Mart
ETL & Data Integration: Netezza, Informatica IICS, Informatica 10.2.1
Impact & Value Delivered:
By driving data-driven digital transformation in the Insurance & Reinsurance sector, successfully delivered scalable analytics solutions,
enhanced data quality, and enabled clients to make informed business decisions—leading to revenue growth, operational stability, and
long-term client trust.

Established an Offshore Development Centre (ODC) and streamlined delivery processes to enhance efficiency.
Successfully turned around a high-risk, red-status account in the transportation domain, stabilizing operations, restoring customer
confidence, and securing a contract renewal.
Actively contributed to pre-sales initiatives, leveraging deep domain expertise to drive new business opportunities.
Governance & Agile Leadership:
Internal Leadership Reviews – Oversaw account management, including growth strategy, margin optimization, staffing, risk & issue

Agile & Scrum Best Practices:

o Conducted retrospectives, identifying key areas for continuous improvement.
Risk & Issue Management, Root-Cause Analysis, and Change Management to ensure high-quality deliveries.
Contract & Invoice Management, ensuring seamless financial and operational alignment with client expectations.
Maintained an ongoing client leadership review & feedback loop to drive transparency and sustained collaboration.

unresolved_details.text: SYNOPSIS
Mastering the art of turning red-status projects into success stories, having led multi-million-dollar portfolios and scaled
operations from $2.5M to $10M, while managing teams of 100+ experts.
AREAS OF EXPERTISE & INTEREST
Program & Project Management: Proven track record of successfully delivering complex programs, including both new initiatives and
red-status recoveries, ensuring seamless execution and value realization.
Strategic Planning & Agile Transformation: Skilled in driving product & technology planning through dependency commit in Jira,
“Now”, “Next” and “Later” refinement of roadmap, agile methodologies, lean tools, and data-driven decision-making to improve financial
product delivery and operational resilience.
End-to-End FinTech Product Lifecycle Management: Deep understanding of digital payments, BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later), Collections
platforms for Consumers and Merchants, and AI-powered financial insights, ensuring seamless product development, compliance, and
market adoption.
Technology Leadership: Led high-impact programs leveraging Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Google
Visualization, AI/ML-driven financial analytics,
Informatica IICS, Full Stack Web & Mobile App Development, DevOps, SIEM, OpenText, and SAP to enhance financial product offerings
and regulatory compliance.
Migration Expertise: Led high-impact platform-migration and cloud-migration programs to successful completion.
Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Established efficient workflows for delivering projects/programs in payment
systems, collections, digital lending, credit risk assessment, and financial data processing, fostering a culture of continuous improvement,
enhanced collaboration, and real-time visibility into operations.
Revenue Growth & Business Expansion: Managed $10M in annual revenue and a team of 100 experts, successfully scaling a FinTech
account from $2.5M to $10M by optimizing product delivery, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring regulatory alignment.
Global Markets & Client Engagement: Extensive experience in ecosystems across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, working with major
organizations such as PayPal, Chubb, Shell, Thomson Reuters, Thames Water, Nike, and Hanes. Six years of on-site experience in the USA
& UK, driving innovation and operational excellence.
Business Strategy: Expertise in account governance
, pre-sales support, P&L management, and stakeholder engagement to secure high-
value projects and partnerships.
